name: phoenix-desk-tools
author: 上海锟钛
description: Phoenix 桌面辅助工具 — 根目录 pnpm 命令转发至 web-ui

scripts.verify:real-fcstd: pnpm -C server exec vitest run src/lib/fcstdDocumentXmlService.test.ts src/lib/fcstdReferenceLabelService.test.ts
scripts.dev: node scripts/run-with-phoenix-wing.mjs local -- pnpm run dev:services
scripts.dev:local-wing: node scripts/run-with-phoenix-wing.mjs local -- pnpm run dev:services
scripts.dev:registry: node scripts/run-with-phoenix-wing.mjs registry -- pnpm run dev:services
scripts.tauri:dev: node scripts/run-with-phoenix-wing.mjs local -- cargo tauri dev
scripts.tauri:dev:registry: node scripts/run-with-phoenix-wing.mjs registry -- cargo tauri dev
scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:ts && pnpm test:caa && echo '' && echo '📊 测试报告: open test-report/index.html (或 npx serve test-report)'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C server typecheck && pnpm -C web-ui typecheck
scripts.test:caa: pnpm run test:core && pnpm run test:web
scripts.test:local-wing: node scripts/run-with-phoenix-wing.mjs local -- pnpm run test:wing-consumers
scripts.test:registry: node scripts/run-with-phoenix-wing.mjs registry -- pnpm run test:wing-consumers
scripts.build:local-wing: node scripts/run-with-phoenix-wing.mjs local -- pnpm run build:wing-consumers
scripts.build:registry: node scripts/run-with-phoenix-wing.mjs registry -- pnpm run build:wing-consumers
scripts.build:wing-consumers: pnpm -C web-ui build && pnpm -C server build:bundle
scripts.verify:ci: pnpm docs:check && pnpm verify:architecture && pnpm verify:wing-dependencies && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm build:tauri-runtime
